# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 14 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** The Faithful LORD and His Devout Ones

---

**14:1** The LORD is faithful to those who truly love him,
to those who endure his discipline;

**14:2** to those who walk in the righteousness of his commandments,
in the law he commanded us for our life.

**14:3** The devout of the LORD will live by it forever;
the trees of life in the LORD's Paradise are his devout ones.

**14:4** Their planting is rooted forever;
they shall not be uprooted for all the days of heaven.

**14:5** For the portion and inheritance of God is Israel.

**14:6** But it is not so with sinners and transgressors,
who love only the brief season of their sinful company;

**14:7** their delight is in fleeting corruption,
and they keep no thought of God.

**14:8** For the ways of men are known before the LORD,
and he knows the secrets of the heart before they are formed.

**14:9** Therefore their inheritance is Hades, darkness, and destruction;
they shall not be found on the day when the righteous receive mercy.

**14:10** But the devout of the LORD shall inherit life in gladness.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA.*
